name: Eliel
overview: Eliel was a male member of the tribe of Benjamin, identified specifically as the son of Shashak. His mention in Scripture is brief and primarily genealogical, providing a link within the Benjaminite lineage. There are no additional notes or events recorded about his life.
namesAndTitles: The name Eliel means 'G-d is my God,' reflecting a declaration of faith in the one true God. This proper name is recorded in 1 Chronicles 8:22 and was not given directly by God but holds a theologically rich meaning.
familyAndRelationships: Eliel is explicitly identified as the son of Shashak, establishing a direct paternal relationship. Scripture does not provide further family details beyond this connection.
scriptureSignificance: Eliel's significance lies in his role within the genealogical records of the tribe of Benjamin, helping to preserve the lineage and heritage of God's chosen people. While not prominent in narrative events, his inclusion in 1 Chronicles underscores the importance of maintaining accurate genealogies for the community of Israel.
